summary: Highlands REIT, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing a self-tender offer to purchase up to $25.0 million of its common stock at $0.20 per share, representing up to 125,000,000 shares. The offer expires September 29, 2026, and is funded with cash on hand. Odd lots are accepted first, then pro rata if oversubscribed. The company may increase purchases by up to 2% of outstanding shares without extension. No advisor, premium, or board recommendation details are provided. Watch for oversubscription pro rata and any price movement versus the $0.20 tender price.
